sections.heading: Forgotten password and missing reset email
sections.text: Users reset a forgotten password themselves with the Forgot password link on the sign-in page. The reset email can take several minutes to arrive.

steps.text: Direct the user to the Forgot password link on the sign-in page.
Ask the user to check their spam or junk folder for the reset email.

information_needed.prompt: When the user last requested the reset email.

stop_conditions.text: Tier 1 staff do not reset passwords on a user's behalf. If self-service reset fails, route to an authorized administrator using the documented verification procedure.
